calendar_guide.description: My Calendar lets you view your personal events alongside events from your teams and organizations, all in one screen.

what.title: What is My Calendar?
what.body: View all events from your teams, organizations, and personal schedule in a single calendar. Switch between the calendar view and the Gantt view (TODO list).

add.title: Add an event
add.body: Click the 'Add event' button or click on a date in the calendar to create an event. You can add personal events as well as team or organization events.
add.step1: Click 'Add event' in the top right, or click on a date cell
add.step2: Enter a title, date/time, and location
add.step3: Select personal, team, or organization under 'Scope'

filter.title: Filter the view
filter.body: Use the buttons at the bottom of the calendar to toggle the display of each scope (personal, team, organization). If there are 6 or more, use the dropdown to select.

gantt.title: Gantt view (TODO list)
gantt.body: Press the 'Gantt' tab to display deadline-based TODOs as a Gantt chart. It syncs with the scope switcher in the top right to show personal, team, or organization TODOs.

detail.title: Event details & attendance
detail.body: Click on an event in the calendar to open the detail panel on the right.
detail.item_edit: Use the pencil icon to edit, or the trash icon to delete
detail.item_attendance: For events with attendance tracking, select 'Attending', 'Not attending', or 'Maybe'
detail.item_match: Use the 'Record this match' button from a team event to start a match record

google_sync.title: Google Calendar integration
google_sync.body: Connect your Google account to sync your personal events with Google Calendar in both directions. Events you add or edit in Mannschaft appear in Google Calendar, and changes made in Google Calendar are imported back.
google_sync.step2: Press 'Connect Google account' and authorize the connection
google_sync.step3: Turn on 'Personal calendar' to enable syncing
google_sync.step4: Run 'Manual sync' when you want changes reflected immediately

schedule.google_sync_notice: Connected to Google Calendar. Any changes made in Google will be replaced by Mannschaft data the next time you save this event here.
